gpu: RX 9070 XT gfx1201, RADV, default 330 W cap
method: Three interleaved trials per pair; 48 warmup and 100 timed evaluations per run; median of trial medians; whole-evaluation Vulkan timestamps. Input is the official-probe patterned input with four jitters, NOT a game-quality test.

gelu.method: 100 warmup rounds of all 3 variants, 7 rotated/reversed trials, each averages 10 launches of 4096 dependent iterations on 8 independent channels; 1,048,576 single-iteration input values checked including all binary16 encodings. NaN payloads ignored. Does not measure an L evaluation.

rgp.method: RGP 2.7.1 under Xvfb :78; one trace of the optimized control; traced durations include instrumentation overhead and are not benchmark timings.

native_static_instruction_counts_note: Exported evaluation kernels only, excluding prep; static counts include loop bodies once, so are NOT per-wave dynamic instruction counts.

experiment_flags.wpw1: LVAR_BASE=-DM_RELAXED -DWPW=1 -DM_RESIDUAL_F32, plus the five current L stage optimization defines
